fidelity: F2a -- Thevenin 1-RC Equivalent Circuit + Coulomb-counted SOC + Lumped Bernardi Thermal ODE
source: Reimers & Dahn (1992) J. Electrochem. Soc. 139, 2091; Hu, Li & Peng (2012) J. Power Sources 198, 359-367; Bernardi, Pawlikowski & Newman (1985) J. Electrochem. Soc. 132(1), 5-12; Forgez et al. (2010) J. Power Sources 195, 2961-2968; Thomas & Newman (2003) J. Electrochem. Soc. 150(2), A176-A192

unit.name: Generic LCO 18650 cell (LiCoO2 cathode / graphite anode) -- Physics-Lumped Thevenin 1-RC

capacity_ref.note: Nominal capacity at T_ref (reused from F1b)

R0_ref.note: Series ohmic resistance at T_ref; instantaneous IR jump (Hu et al. 2012). Reused split of F1b R_ref=0.060: R0+R1~=R_total

R1_ref.note: Charge-transfer / diffusion polarization resistance of the RC pair at T_ref

C1_ref.note: Polarization capacitance; tau1 = R1*C1 ~ 30 s, typical Li-ion mid-frequency relaxation (Hu et al. 2012)

T_ref.note: Reference temperature (25 degC), reused from F1b

E_a_R0.note: Arrhenius activation energy for R0; LCO higher E_a than NMC (Jalkanen et al. 2015; Forgez et al. 2010)

E_a_R1.note: Arrhenius activation energy for R1; charge-transfer polarization more thermally activated than ohmic term

coulombic_eff.note: Coulombic efficiency on charge (0<eff<1); LCO/graphite consumer cell

m_cell.note: Mass of an 18650 LCO cell (~45 g)

cp_cell.note: Lumped specific heat of 18650 cell (Forgez et al. 2010 measured ~830-900)

hA_cell.note: Convective heat-transfer coeff x surface area for natural convection of an 18650 (Forgez et al. 2010)

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5 (sloping 3.0-4.2 V, layered LiCoO2)
ocv_coefficients.source: Reused from EC022 F1b; polynomial fit to representative LCO discharge curve (Reimers & Dahn 1992)

temperature.note: 0 to 45 degC; LCO normal Li-ion operating range
